name: SEC EDGAR (sec.gov, www.sec.gov, data.sec.gov)
margins: The SEC allows 10 requests per second and a 10 minute wait after being limited; Titan uses 8 and 15 so it stays clear of the line.

rules.summary: No more than 10 requests per second in total, however many machines or connectors are used.
rules.enforced_by: code: one request budget shared by every process and code path (data/policy_state.db)
rules.quote: Current guidelines limit each user to a total of no more than 10 requests per second, regardless of the number of machines used to submit requests.

rules.summary: After being limited, wait until the request rate has stayed under the limit for 10 minutes.
rules.enforced_by: code: a 403 or 429 from sec.gov pauses all sec.gov requests for the cooldown
rules.quote: Once the rate of requests has dropped below the threshold for 10 minutes, the user may resume accessing content on SEC.gov.

rules.summary: The SEC may block IP addresses that send excessive requests.
rules.quote: We reserve the right to block IP addresses that submit excessive requests.

rules.summary: Every request must declare who is calling: a name and a contact email in the User-Agent.
rules.enforced_by: code: requests to sec.gov are refused unless TITAN_CONTACT holds an email address
rules.quote: Please declare your user agent in request headers:

rules.summary: The SEC's sample headers ask for gzip, deflate compression.
rules.enforced_by: code: Accept-Encoding is set to gzip, deflate on requests to sec.gov

rules.summary: Do not crawl the site with bots or automated tools.
rules.enforced_by: code: site discovery (sitemaps, link following) and browser rendering are refused for sec.gov; only named documents and the data.sec.gov APIs are fetched
rules.quote: The SEC does not allow botnets or automated tools to crawl the site.

rules.summary: Download only what is needed, and prefer the bulk files for large amounts of data.
rules.enforced_by: guideline plus call budgets in the connector manifest (per run and per day); not a hard check
rules.quote: Download only what you need and please moderate requests to minimize server load.

rules.summary: For large amounts of API data, use the nightly bulk ZIP files instead of many API calls.
rules.quote: The most efficient means to fetch large amounts of API data is the bulk archive ZIP files, which are recompiled nightly.

rules.summary: The data.sec.gov APIs need no key, so the connector must not send one.
rules.enforced_by: code: a manifest for a sec.gov host is refused unless its auth type is none and its rate limit is within the budget
rules.quote: These APIs do not require any authentication or API keys to access.
